application.name: Height Map
application.description: A 2.5D elevation map and its traversability on the GPU with holoscan-height-map: a synthetic depth camera drives over a course with a ramp, steps, a box and a pit; holoscan-point-cloud's DepthToPointCloudOp deprojects each depth image, HeightMapOp maps the clouds with the camera's pose into a window that follows it, and TraversabilityOp computes slope, step height and a cost; every map is checked against the course's truth, and HoloViz shows the elevation beside the cost.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-height-map demo, with a synthetic terrain camera, a ground-truth reporter and a HoloViz view.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Map 300 frames of the synthetic camera driving over the course, check each map against its truth, and show the elevation and cost when a display is available.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 60 synthetic 640x480 frames into a 200x200 map that follows the camera; the elevation error away from height jumps, the ramp's slope, the steps' heights, the box's lethal rim, the free ground's cost and the window's position, checked against the truth.
